feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 12 October 2026 6:55am
items.description:
##Today##

Occasional rain & drizzle becoming patchy, becoming misty in places, chance of coastal fog patches. Spell of heavy rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S or SE 20-25, soon veering S or SW 15-20, increasing 20-25 in the evening, then 25-30 with gusts of 40-45 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Occasionally very poor in any fog patches. Hill fog until later. Becoming good later.


##Comments##

Strong wind. Risk of slight coastal overtopping at time of high tide.


##Tomorrow##

Dry with sunny spells at first, risk of showers developing the afternoon and evening, possibly heavy in places.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 15°C

##Wind Speed##

22

SW


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong winds.
